goal: Make a diff that deletes, skips, retries or loosens a Python test visible on the pull request before it merges, so 'never skip or weaken a test' is checked rather than remembered (roadmap R29, unit 3).
changed: verify-work gains scripts/test_guard.py: --base REF [--head REF] compares each changed Python test file with its copy at the merge base, function by function, and prints every test deleted or moved and every skip, retry, wider timeout or tolerance, dropped assertion, or exact assertion traded for a weaker one. It exits 0, and 2 only when it cannot run.
verify-work's step 7 runs it whenever a diff touches Python tests, and an unexplained finding makes the verdict NOT VERIFIED.
agent-kit's .agents/checklist.json gains tests-weakened, which fires on any diff under tests/ and runs the guard as its probe.

claims.claim: On agent-kit's history the guard reports the three tests 990c84f renamed or replaced, reports the nine debrief tests 1782b7c deleted by an accidental revert, and prints nothing on docs-only cb5299b.
claims.check: python3 test_guard.py --base C^ --head C for each commit, under /usr/bin/python3 3.9.6; HistoryTest replays 990c84f and cb5299b in the suite

claims.claim: Every rule is held by a test: switching any one of fifteen rules off turns at least one test in tests/test_test_guard.py red.
